Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: Since we stand here without une destination, I should ask you a strange question.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: I have une cachette on the tree, in a crevice that was not used for some time by anyone else. It is where I keep le vin, because it is cooler than chez-moi.

Entries.Name: French Kweebec
Entries.Line: When I went there for a refill, I noticed that one of mes caisses was opened. I ...

Line.Text: I have seen you go there. I understand that there is no reason to supposer that I have anything to do with that stockage, and I am not intending to accuse you of thievery.
